sessions.description: What an agent's browser opens as, and how many may be open at once. A shorter idle timeout also reaches sessions that are already open.

idleTimeout.description: A session with no agent activity for this long is closed and its memory released.

allowedOrigins.description: One origin per line. Leave empty to allow every site.
